questionText: In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. options.text: Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows.
options.textHi: न तो निष्कर्ष I, II और न ही I अनुसरण करता है।

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow.
